title: Make a product launch video with music using an agent
summary: Huashu had Claude Code make launch films with self-written music and click-to-edit fixes; he reports twenty films in one day and one costing about 2 yuan.
agent_role: The agent reads the product, offers three directions, writes the animation and a music score, then fixes only the spot the person clicks and comments on. The person picks a direction and gives feedback.
outcome: Author reports 20 films made in one day, and a 22-second film with a cheaper model in under half an hour for 1.95 yuan.
what_they_did: Huashu built a skill so Claude Code or Codex can make short product launch videos in code. You ask for a 30-second film. The agent reads your product, offers three looks, writes the film and composes music. You click on any frame in a browser editor to request a change.
how_it_went: He reports making 20 films in one day. A 22-second film made with DeepSeek took three rounds of feedback, under half an hour, and cost 1.95 yuan. A 30-second film renders in about 12 to 15 seconds on his Mac.
worth_knowing: The agent cannot hear, so you must judge the music yourself. It only draws with code, so real people or footage must come from your own material.
prompt: Install the huashu-motion skill from github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-motion and run the demo. Then make a 30-second launch film for my product at [website]. Read the product first and show me three directions to pick from before writing the film. Compose the music, open the editor, and wait for my comments before exporting.

curation.rationale: Detailed, working skill with reported results: twenty launch films in a day and a cheap-model film made in under half an hour, with code and samples.
